# Security lifecycle test fixtures

These JSON files preserve the MOPS API response shape and the relevant
official 5371 share-conversion rows for deterministic unit tests.  The list
response is intentionally reduced and the detail files are test fixtures, not
the exact raw custody files used for the 2026-09-15 evidence run.  They must
not be described as exact raw verification or used as formal source evidence.

The exact raw custody files and their hashes remain outside the repository in
the read-only verification directory recorded by the security-lifecycle QA
note.
